name: Entomology PhD
detailsNote: Official annual information is available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Admission model not explicit. Curriculum allows a bachelor-entry credit total, but admission checklist requires a thesis master; confirm any direct-entry exception.

publishedDeadlines.label: University fallback fall deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: General university date only when no program deadline; international applicants advised to complete 60–90 days before program deadline. Verify department date.

applicationFee.note: International fee; waiver only for current OSU students or alumni (one application). General domestic categories include military/veterans and selected federal programs. No general international hardship waiver.

english.toefl: 79 old scale; 4.0 on new scale beginning January 21,2026
english.note: PTE 53 also accepted centrally; program may require higher scores or restrict tests. Scores valid two years; official final reports needed. Documented English-degree waiver may be requested under country/instruction criteria, subject to approval. Teaching assignments have separate speaking/ITA requirements.

documents: Uploaded transcripts; unofficial copies for review, official final records
Letter of intent on research/professional goals
requirements.note: Thesis-based master required by admission checklist; GRE official scores required. Recommended preparation spans entomology, biological/physical sciences, organic chemistry/labs, physiology, anatomy/taxonomy, genetics, statistics/calculus, biochemistry and ecology.

funding.note: Graduate research assistantship opportunities under major adviser for at least 20 hours/week; universal award and benefits not specified.
